slice: natural explaining: a salmon's genome an artifact of its kind's prior healthy living, its stable form aiming a salmon into healthy living

items.text: A salmon lives with its genome, an artifact of its kind's prior living, year round, in healthy living and ingesting conditions, river and ocean; that artifact's stable form co-sequentially, geodesically aims a salmon into healthy living, out to the waters where its kind feeds well and home up its river at its season, from each is-not to is. A "map", a "program", a "magnetic sense" and a "memory" going down generations are a field's store story over that. A young self opens with two priors: its elders' going, a crane's route straightening as it flies with older cranes, and its kind's artifact, a salmon's heading with no ocean of its own yet.

items.section: 4.6 A reaching's competency constant, a gathering's climbing
items.text: Juvenile Chinook salmon from a hatchery, more than 1,000 of them, none ever in the ocean, each some eight minutes in a bucket inside a platform of copper wires making a field an instrument reads as that of the northern edge of their kind's ocean range, tend to swim south, and with the field of the far southern edge of that range, tend to swim north, toward the waters where their kind feeds; in the test site's own field they swim in random directions. The researchers name it a map sense a fish inherits, a fish "programmed to know what to do": a self observing reads a young salmon's heading toward its kind's healthy feeding as one with no ocean yet of its own, its genome an artifact of its kind's prior living and its stable form aiming it.
items.from: v393E exploring, a salmon's genome an artifact of healthy living

items.section: 4.6 A reaching's competency constant, a gathering's climbing
items.text: Chinook salmon and steelhead each go up their rivers in two forms, a premature form months ahead of spawning, spring Chinook and summer steelhead, and a mature form ready to spawn, fall Chinook and winter steelhead; across hundreds of thousands of genome points, one region, GREB1L, tells the two forms apart completely in both species, each species' premature form tracing to one evolutionary event of its own. A salmon's season of going home is its kind's artifact of prior living with its river's seasons, its stable form co-sequencing a salmon with its river.
